app.name: traqfreq
nav.label: Lines
map.title: Map
map.lede: Each module is a line. Solid lines are on; dashed lines are off and stay out of the nav until they're switched on.
map.summary: The map shows {n} lines. On: {on}. Off: {off}.
map.offNote: Switch it on with TRAQFREQ_MODULES and restart.
desc.L: Your tracks, albums and artists, read from jimbo-dj.
desc.H: What you played and when, from Plex and Last.fm.
desc.T: Genre tags and the ladder that sorts them.
desc.D: New music near what you already play.
desc.M: Playlists built from the lines you set.
desc.F: Releases you don't have yet, fetched with a preview first.
desc.S: The legacy database, its last scan and jobs, and which modules are on.
empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.L: LIBRARY reads your tracks from jimbo-dj's database, and this one has no tracks table. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
empty.H: HISTORY reads your plays from jimbo-dj's database, and this one has no listens table. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
empty.T: TAGS arrives in P4. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
empty.D: DISCOVER arrives in P7. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
empty.M: MIXES arrives in P7. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
empty.F: FETCH arrives in P7. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
search.title: Search
search.empty: Search arrives with LIBRARY in P2. SETUP shows what traqfreq can read now.
notFound.title: No such page
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or its module is off.
setup.lede: traqfreq reads jimbo-dj's database and never writes to it. jimbo-dj keeps every write until each module's cut-over.
setup.db.failedBody: traqfreq can't open jimbo-dj's database. Set TRAQFREQ_LEGACY_DB to the path of jimbodj.sqlite, mount its folder read-only, and restart.
setup.measure.tracks.rule: Tracks the last Plex sync still saw (removed_at is empty).
setup.measure.albums.rule: Distinct album keys of those tracks.
setup.measure.artists.rule: Distinct artist keys of those tracks.
setup.measure.plays.rule: Listens of 30 s or more that aren't a duplicate (counted = 1).
setup.measure.unstored: jimbo-dj has no stored count to compare.
setup.db.source: Read when this page opened. Rows per table are raw counts; the numbers above are counted the way jimbo-dj counts them.
setup.scan.none: No scan recorded in jimbo-dj's database.
setup.scan.source: From meta.last_sync, set by jimbo-dj after each Plex sync.
setup.jobs.none: No jobs recorded in jimbo-dj's database.
setup.jobs.source: Finished history imports, from history_imports. Running jobs live in jimbo-dj's memory and show only in jimbo-dj.
setup.modules.source: Set with TRAQFREQ_MODULES. LIBRARY and SETUP are always on.
history.failedBody: traqfreq can't read jimbo-dj's listens. SETUP shows whether the database is readable and what to set.
history.plays.rule: Listens of 30 s or more that aren't a repeat or a duplicate (counted = 1), as jimbo-dj decided after its last import.
history.differs: jimbo-dj's stored count is {n}; it is rebuilt hourly, so compare again after its next rebuild.
history.unstored: jimbo-dj has no stored count to compare.
history.once.listens.rule: Every listen jimbo-dj imported from Last.fm, Plex, Spotify and Apple Music.
history.once.repeat.rule: The same source logged the play twice within 30 s.
history.once.duplicate.rule: A source ahead in jimbo-dj's order (Last.fm, Plex, Spotify, Apple Music) has the same play.
history.addsUp: Adds up: plays, too short, repeats and duplicates make every listen.
history.addsUpNotBody: Some listens are in no bucket or in two. jimbo-dj's flags may be mid-import; open the page again after the import finishes.
history.matched.rule: Plays whose song jimbo-dj matched to a library track (the listen's track, else its match).
history.songs: {heard} songs heard, {matched} of them matched to the library.
history.songs.rule: Rows of listen_matches: one per artist and title heard, however each source spelled it.
history.heat.summary: Plays per day, {from} to {to}: {plays} plays on {lit} of {days} days. {busiest}
history.heat.rule: Plays per day in {tz}. Level 0 is no plays; levels 1 to 4 are the quarters of these days with plays.
history.top.rule: All plays by artist, one name per artist however each source spelled it (the library's spelling first, else the most played). {n} artists heard.
history.top.matches: Same as jimbo-dj's stored top artists.
history.top.differs: Differs from jimbo-dj's stored top artists, which are rebuilt hourly.
history.sources.rule: Each source's listens, in jimbo-dj's order. A duplicate counts for the source ahead of it.
history.years.rule: Plays per year in {tz}, jimbo-dj's listening time zone.
history.cache: Built {at} in {s} s from jimbo-dj's data, kept in traqfreq's own database until jimbo-dj imports, rematches or syncs.
rows.total: {n} in all, newest first. Showing {a} to {b}.
rows.failed: Can't read these rows. Check the filters in the address, or open SETUP.
history.once.why: Why each one isn't a play
counted.title: Counted once
counted.intro: Each repeat and duplicate, the listen it repeats or duplicates and how far apart they were. Then three checks jimbo-dj doesn't make. Nothing here changes a count: plays stay as jimbo-dj counted them until HISTORY takes over its writes.
counted.loading: Matching repeats and duplicates to their plays.
counted.gaps.rule: A repeat is of the nearest earlier listen from the same source and song within 30 s. A duplicate is of the nearest play from the source ahead of it, same song, within jimbo-dj's window. The gap is the time between their starts.
counted.gaps.allFound: Every one has its listen in the window.
counted.pair.windows: Window {a}, or {b} for Apple Music's daily summary.
counted.checks.rule: Over the {n} jimbo-dj counted, in order of their start. A play can be in more than one check. These plays still count.
counted.burst.body: Plays starting too close together to have been heard: each under 30 s after the one before.
counted.loop.body: The same song 10 or more times in a row, nothing between, each within an hour.
counted.rhythm.body: 10 or more plays of 3 or more songs, started on a timer: every gap within 2 s of the first. Albums vary in track length; a scrobbler bot replaying a list doesn't.
rows.why.ofNone: no listen in its window; jimbo-dj may be mid-import
rows.why.ofNotPlay: that listen isn't a play either
history.periods.body: Every year's plays and hours, a wrapped summary of a year, month or day, on this day, and top artists, songs and albums for any period.
years.title: Years
years.rule: Plays and hours per year in {tz}, jimbo-dj's listening time zone. Hours are each play's length: what was played, else the track's length (Last.fm), else 3 min 45 s.
years.otd.list: On this day in earlier years
years.otd.none: No plays on this date in earlier years.
years.otd.rule: Plays on today's date in each earlier year, with that day's three most played songs.
years.highlights.rule: The same highlights jimbo-dj's home page shows, worked out from the plays the same way.
years.daysPlayed: Plays on {pct} % of days since the first
wrapped.title: Wrapped {period}
wrapped.rule: Plays in this period in {tz}, jimbo-dj's listening time zone, worked out the way jimbo-dj's wrapped pages work them out.
wrapped.hours.rule: Each play's length: what was played, else the track's length (Last.fm), else 3 min 45 s.
wrapped.top.summary: The top {n} of {of}, one name each however each source spelled it.
wrapped.albums.summary: The top {n}; a play that names no album counts for its library track's.
wrapped.allTop: Every artist, song and album in {period}
top.title: Top {kind}, {period}
top.byPlays: Most plays first; ties by minutes, then name.
top.byMinutes: Most minutes first; ties by plays, then name.
top.rule: Plays in {tz}, grouped under one name per artist, song and album, as jimbo-dj's top lists group them.
compare.title: Every stored number next to jimbo-dj's
compare.intro: jimbo-dj keeps its HISTORY numbers in its database: the overview, and a wrapped summary of each year, month and day it built. Each one is here next to traqfreq's for the same period.
compare.staleNote: {differ} differ, {explained} of them stored before jimbo-dj's latest data.
compare.none: jimbo-dj has stored no HISTORY numbers yet.
library.failedBody: traqfreq couldn't read jimbo-dj's library numbers. SETUP shows whether jimbo-dj's database is readable.
library.head: The library in numbers
library.unstored: jimbo-dj hasn't stored its own copy of these numbers yet.
library.storedFresh: jimbo-dj's stored copy is from the same sync.
library.storedStale: jimbo-dj's stored copy is older than its last sync, so it may differ.
library.bars.noBitrate: {n} with no bitrate, in no bucket.
library.plays.note: These are Plex's own counts. A track's plays on its rows are jimbo-dj's: Plex's count or the history's plays, whichever is larger, never the sum.
library.top.none: No artist has Plex plays yet.
library.top.note: Each opens that artist's played tracks. HISTORY counts every source.
library.sonic.what: Plex's own analysis, done by the Plex server. traqfreq only reads whether it ran.
library.analyzer.what: jimbo-dj's own analysis of the audio files, version {v}: key and BPM come from here.
library.unmapped.rule: Tracks minus mapped: no local path jimbo-dj can read
library.folders.why: These depend on jimbo-dj's settings and the disks its container sees, which traqfreq can't see. Shown as jimbo-dj stored them.
library.cache: Built {at} in {s} s and kept until jimbo-dj's next sync, import or analysis result.
library.rows.code: Key and BPM only where jimbo-dj's analyzer finished at its current version.
library.rows.failed: Can't read these tracks. Check the filters in the address, or open SETUP.
entity.failed: Can't read this page from jimbo-dj's database. Check the address, or open SETUP.
entity.album.notFound: No live album has this key. The last Plex sync may have removed it; open LIBRARY to find it again.
entity.artist.notFound: No live artist has this key. The last Plex sync may have removed it; open LIBRARY to find it again.
entity.track.notFound: No track has this key in jimbo-dj's database. Open LIBRARY to find it again.
entity.plays.notFound: That track, album or artist isn't in the library. Go back and open it again.
entity.list.sort.name: By name
entity.list.order.name: by name
entity.list.none: No live tracks, so no albums or artists.
entity.album.label: Label (Plex)
entity.mb.none: jimbo-dj hasn't looked this album up in MusicBrainz yet.
entity.mb.note: As jimbo-dj cached it. traqfreq doesn't look anything up.
entity.notHere: Not on this page yet: album art (jimbo-dj fetches it from Plex), genres and styles (TAGS), the sound profile and MusicBrainz lookups.
entity.artist.albumsSummary: {n} of its own, and on {on} of other people's.
entity.artist.notHere: Not on this page yet: MusicBrainz (what it is, members, links), the sound profile, artists that sound like it and its styles (TAGS).
entity.track.plexWhat: view_count, from the last Plex sync
entity.track.removed: Removed {d}: the last Plex sync no longer saw it
entity.track.notHere: Not on this page yet: genres and styles (TAGS), the sound profile and similar tracks.
entity.analysis.current: Analysed at version {v}, the current one.
entity.analysis.older: {s} at version {v}; the current version is {cur}, so it will be analysed again.
entity.feat.older: From version {v}: the rows pages show key and BPM only from the current version.
